sam: Heads-up: quiet window 02:00-03:30 UTC to roll kernel+quant v3.0 (quantize3) — enables int8 matmul and new permute kernels.
ei: Ack. Plan? tenant-sliced rollout + infra-only first?
sam: Yes. Infra-only -> low-traffic tenants -> standard -> dedicated (dedicated pinned until signoff). Use tenant-slice flags.
rachel: Note: softmax scaling changed slightly; rerank golden checks required. Might affect search highlight determinism.
troy: Also watch embeddings drift. Last rollout saw ~0.02 cosine drop for some models. Gate threshold at 0.98 median.
sam: Command: `/deploybot rollout kernel quantize3 --strategy tenant-slice --slices 5 --quiet-window 02:00-03:30`
ei: Gates: rerank fail rate >0.2% -> hold, embedding median <0.98 -> hold, request-error >0.3% for 3m -> rollback.
infra-bot: preflight started. Artifact hash OK. Golden-eval queued. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/quantize3-rollout
infra-bot: golden-eval: 11/12 pass, failing case a long-rerank edge.
rachel: That one is the expected softmax edge. Proposal: enable runtime logit-normalize shim for canaries to reduce drift.
troy: Perf cost unknown; run perf-local with shim.
ei: Perf-local shows ~4% CPU, ~1.5% median latency bump with shim. Acceptable for standard but keep dedicated pinned.
sam: Proceed infra-only at 02:00, then low-traffic tenants with shim. Dedicated remains pinned.
deploybot: rollout scheduled by sam for 1739000000. Starting infra-only deploy.
infra-bot: infra-only smoke PASS. Perf normals.
deploybot: started slice 1 (low-traffic) with `--flags logit-normalize`. Monitoring enabled.
infra-bot: early metrics: rerank drift +0.03%, embed median 0.989 (improved with shim). One tenant reported highlight diffs; auto-pin applied.
deploybot: auto-pin applied for tenant-08 due to embed drift.
sam: We'll proceed with staged standard rollout at ~03:05 but keep dedicated pinned. Create INF-5012 to track dedicated unpin criteria and perf cost.
rachel: I'll draft release note: summary, known small rerank drift, mitigation (logit-normalize), dedicated pinned, contact channel.
troy: I'll run perf sweep on representative dedicated hosts overnight.
ei: CI will run full golden-eval against standard set; if failures >0.1% abort and pin.
sam: Thanks. Closing thread after notes and issues created. Reopen if new anomalies. :eyes:
